Thesis
Analysis and Defense Against Rootkit Attacks

Studied rootkit types, attack stages and detection methods (signature, behavior, integrity and learning based), with real cases targeting Mongolia such as MysterySnail and APT29. Built a Linux rootkit detector in C and Python with a kernel module and a user-space CLI that:

  • checks the syscall table for hooked addresses
  • finds hidden processes by comparing the task list with /proc
  • finds hidden kernel modules via kobject and module lists
  • inspects IDT / SSDT entries and scans /etc, /var for hidden files
